name: Googol Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Googol Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of motion control products in China and internationally. The company provides motion controller, including card type, embedded, networked computer programmable automation controller-computer programmable, and automation controller; drive and control integration; motor driver, such as servo, steppe, and spindle drive; and line laser scanning 3D camera. It also offers software platform, including MotionStudio motion controller debugging software; OtoStudio software development platform; and Driverstudio servo drive debugging software.
